title: Dadu aur Tuffy ka Raaz
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, cute expressive characters with big eyes, exaggerated funny facial expressions, vibrant colors, soft cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16

narrator.look: A male storyteller, warm and clear.

Dadu.look: Old, kind man, fair skin, thin white hair, spectacles, wearing a clean white kurta-pajama, always with a warm smile. Bright soft light on his face.

Rani.look: Young woman, fair skin, long wavy dark-brown hair, natural makeup, small gold earrings, wearing a graceful pastel yellow kurta with neat jeans. Bright soft light on her face.

Tuffy.look: Small, fluffy white terrier mix dog, wearing a blue collar, very expressive, mischievous eyes, wagging tail.

hook_text: DOG SIRF DADU SE BAAT KARTA HAI?

scenes.image: Close-up on Tuffy, a fluffy white terrier mix dog, looking directly at the camera with wide, mischievous eyes, head slightly tilted. A thought bubble above him shows him winking.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mera kutta sirf Dadu se baat karta hai!
scenes.say: मेरा कुत्ता सिर्फ दादू से बात करता है!

scenes.image: Rani stands at the kitchen doorway, looking confused and concerned at Dadu, who is stirring something in a pot, oblivious to her. Tuffy sits beside Dadu's feet, looking up at him expectantly.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Rani ne Dadu ko kitchen mein dekha.
scenes.say: रानी ने दादू को किचन में देखा।

scenes.image: Dadu bends down slightly, holding a spoon, and smiles at Tuffy with affection. Tuffy looks up at Dadu with a happy, eager expression.
scenes.speaker: Dadu

scenes.image: Close-up on Tuffy, who winks at Dadu and nudges his leg playfully. He looks like he's trying to be secretive.
scenes.speaker: Tuffy
scenes.line: Haan Dadu, bohot bhookh lagi hai!
scenes.say: हाँ दादू, बहुत भूख लगी है!

scenes.image: Rani, still at the doorway, looks puzzled, tilting her head. She clearly heard Dadu talking, but no visible response from Tuffy.
scenes.speaker: Rani
scenes.line: Dadu, kisse baat kar rahe ho?
scenes.say: दादू, किससे बात कर रहे हो?

scenes.image: Dadu turns to Rani with a broad, innocent smile, gesturing towards Tuffy who now looks like a normal, quiet dog.
scenes.speaker: Dadu
scenes.line: Arre, Tuffy se! Woh apni pasand bata raha hai.
scenes.say: अरे, टफी से! वो अपनी पसंद बता रहा है।

scenes.image: Rani crosses her arms, looking skeptical. Tuffy glances at her quickly, then back at Dadu, playing innocent.
scenes.speaker: Rani
scenes.line: Dadu, woh to sirf bhonkta hai.
scenes.say: दादू, वो तो सिर्फ भौंकता है।

scenes.image: Rani stands in the living room, looking thoughtful and worried, holding her chin. She's genuinely concerned about Dadu.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Rani ko Dadu ki chinta hone lagi.
scenes.say: रानी को दादू की चिंता होने लगी।

scenes.image: Rani peeks from behind a potted plant in the living room, secretly watching Tuffy, who is sitting alone on the rug, looking bored.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Rani ne Tuffy ko chhupke se dekha.
scenes.say: रानी ने टफी को छुपके से देखा।

scenes.image: Rani crouches down, still hidden, and whispers towards Tuffy, who slowly turns his head, eyes widening slightly.
scenes.speaker: Rani
scenes.line: Tuffy, kya tum sach mein bolte ho?
scenes.say: टफी, क्या तुम सच में बोलते हो?

scenes.image: Tuffy looks left and right furtively, then leans in conspiratorially towards Rani, lowering his head slightly.
scenes.speaker: Tuffy

scenes.image: Rani's face in a close-up, eyes wide with shock and a hand clapped over her mouth. She is utterly surprised.
scenes.speaker: Rani
scenes.line: Tum to sach mein bolte ho!
scenes.say: तुम तो सच में बोलते हो!

scenes.image: Dadu enters the living room, smiling knowingly at Rani and Tuffy, who are both frozen in surprise. Dadu looks amused.
scenes.speaker: Dadu
scenes.line: Kya hua Rani? Tuffy ne kya kaha?
scenes.say: क्या हुआ रानी? टफी ने क्या कहा?

scenes.image: Rani points an accusing finger at Tuffy, who gives a sheepish, guilty look, but also a hint of mischief in his eyes.
scenes.speaker: Rani
scenes.line: Dadu, yeh to... yeh to sab nautanki hai!
scenes.say: दादू, ये तो... ये तो सब नौटंकी है!

scenes.image: Dadu and Tuffy are sitting together, Dadu gently petting Tuffy, both laughing heartily. Dadu's eyes are twinkling, Tuffy has a wide, happy doggy grin.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Tuffy aur Dadu dono hansne lage.
scenes.say: टफी और दादू दोनों हँसने लगे।

scenes.image: Close-up on Tuffy looking directly into the camera with a smug, knowing look, as if sharing a secret with the viewer.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Dadu aur Tuffy mein zyaada chaalak kaun tha?
scenes.say: दादू और टफी में ज़्यादा चालाक कौन था?

caption: My Dog Only Talks To Grandpa... Until This! 😂
yt_title: My Dog Only Talks To Grandpa... Until This! 😂
description:
This talking dog only whispers secrets to Dadu! 🤫
His granddaughter thought Dadu was losing his mind, but then she caught them in a hilarious act. 
Who do you think was more mischievous, Dadu or Tuffy?
comment_question: Dadu aur Tuffy mein zyaada chaalak kaun tha?
